name: KavyaMusic
description: KavyaMusic - A Telegram Music Bot, built with Python, Pyrogram & Py-TgCalls. Stream high-quality music in voice chats seamlessly!

MONGO_DB_URI.description: Get a mongodb url from https://cloud.mongodb.com.

OWNER_ID.description: The user id of user whom you would like to add as OWNER.

STRING_SESSION.description: A Pyrogram v2 String Session from @SHIV_SESSION_BOT on Telegram.

LOGGER_ID.description: Your Log Group ID (group, not channel). Add your bot and promote it as admin with full rights.

ERROR_LOGGER_ID.description: Telegram group ID where uncaught bot errors and tracebacks are reported.

ASSISTANT_START_TIMEOUT.description: Maximum seconds allowed for the assistant to start.

CLEAN_INTERVAL_HOURS.description: Hours between auto clean of thumbnails/downloads (report goes to LOGGER_ID).
